name: Horseshoe Bay
question_title: Can you drive a golf cart in Horseshoe Bay?
answer_short: Yes, on streets posted 35 mph or less. Horseshoe Bay tells residents that Texas law lets a city allow a licensed driver to operate an equipped golf cart on a public road inside the city posted 35 mph or less.

golf_cart.roads: City streets posted 35 mph or less
golf_cart.notes: Licensed driver; slow-moving emblem if under 25 mph

rules.rule: A municipality may allow golf carts on a public highway inside the city posted 35 mph or less. The driver must be licensed, and the cart needs lights, reflectors, a parking brake and mirrors.
Golf carts with the required plate and equipment on roads posted 35 mph or less where the city or county allows them, in daylight

banned_roads.name: RM 2147 and SH 71 where posted over 35 mph

faq.q: Where can I drive my LSV in Horseshoe Bay?
faq.a: Roads posted 35 mph or less. Registered and insured. A town or county can still ban LSVs from a specific road, and posted signs win.

faq.q: Can I drive a golf cart on RM 2147?
faq.a: Only where it is posted 35 mph or less. Much of it is posted higher.

faq.q: Do I need a license to drive a golf cart in Horseshoe Bay?
faq.a: Yes. The city brochure says only a licensed driver may operate a golf cart on a public road.
